Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: transparent Live2D pose candidate.
Image 1 is the exact edit target, the CURRENT avatar. Image 2 is an original visual-novel crossed-arm pose reference ONLY for the arm anatomy, cuffs and folds, NEVER for head, hair color or body angle.
Change ONLY the arms of image 1 into a natural arms-crossed pose across the lower chest. Keep frontal shoulders and the torso's existing orientation. Both forearms cross, hands partially tucked against opposite upper arms, clear elbows and correct anatomy.
NON-NEGOTIABLE: preserve image 1's face, eyes, mouth, hairstyle, hair strands, head angle, neck, white shirt, dark red tie, buttoned white laboratory coat, buttons and pockets. Same exact burgundy hair, blue-violet irises, pale skin, cool white coat. Do NOT redraw or beautify the head. Do not copy orange hair from image 2. Keep the same fine brown/black contours, angular cel-like cloth shadows and subtle original raster texture; no generic modern anime redraw, no airbrushed plastic skin, no new highlights.
Maintain original 1000x1800 canvas, head placement and size; keep avatar from head to below hips and transparent margins. Only alter sleeves, hands and contact folds necessary for crossed arms. Genuine transparent background. No text, grid, interface, scene, glow or watermark. This is a surgical pose edit, not a character redesign.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent Live2D pose artwork candidate.
Image 1 is the EXACT character edit target, not a loose style reference.
Change only ONE arm to a hand-on-waist/hip pose: bend her left elbow outward (viewer right), hand rests visibly on her waist with thumb behind and four relaxed fingers forward over the side of the lab coat. Shoulder-elbow-wrist anatomical chain continuous. Other arm hangs as in the original.
Preserve the original front-facing head, eyes, face outline, small mouth, every hair strand and expression; burgundy hair, blue-violet eyes, pale skin. Preserve the original white collared shirt, narrow dark-red tie, buttoned cool white lab coat, brown cuff lining, pockets and buttons. No brown jacket. Keep original slender proportions and original VN fine brown/black outlines, angular fabric shading, subtle raster texture. Do not redraw or beautify the face; no generic anime-style reinterpretation.
Change sleeves and side contact folds only where required for the hand at the waist. The hand MUST actually touch the waist, not float and not stay down. Relaxed neutral expression, no wink needed.
Same original full portrait composition, head through lower coat, generous transparent margins. Genuinely transparent background, no UI, words, scenery, grids or effects. Surgical arm edit with exact identity preservation.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent Live2D new gesture candidate.
Image 1 is the exact original avatar to edit. Change ONLY her right arm (viewer left): elbow flexed naturally at waist/chest height, forearm raised alongside shoulder, hand near shoulder level with a single INDEX FINGER clearly pointing UP as if making a scientific point. Other fingers folded naturally with thumb against them. Small anatomically correct hand; palm orientation clear. Other arm remains down unchanged. No objects.
Preserve the EXACT original front-facing face, blue-violet eyes, small mouth and neutral facial expression, hairline and all burgundy hair strands. No face repainting, beautification or generic anime redesign. Keep original slender silhouette, cool white buttoned lab coat with original pockets and buttons, brown inner cuffs, white collared shirt and narrow dark-red tie. Match original fine brown/black linework, angular cel-like fabric shadows and subtle VN raster texture, no smooth airbrushed look.
Same full portrait framing head through lower coat with transparent margins. Edit only arm, sleeve, wrist and hand needed for gesture, keep existing head and torso. Real transparent background. No labels, HUD, background, glow or watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent Live2D forward-lean pose artwork.
Image 1 is the current ORIGINAL avatar and absolute identity/style reference. Image 2 supplies ONLY the newly drawn hand-on-waist arrangement; use this arrangement when redrawing torso perspective.
Draw the SAME avatar LEANING FORWARD TOWARD THE VIEWER, hinged at the hips, roughly 20 degrees. This is NOT a sideways tilt of a flat standing sprite. Show genuine foreshortening: head and upper shoulders closer to camera, short visible neck, top planes of shoulders, collar and lapels visible, chest projected forward and waist receding. Keep shoulders relatively level and frontal, not an extreme diagonal rotation. Her left hand (viewer right) MUST rest on her waist with bent outward elbow, as in image 2; her other arm relaxed down. Hand at waist must remain fully visible.
Exact original face identity, narrow face shape, blue-violet eyes, straight burgundy hairstyle, precise original fringe and hair strand design. Keep her ORIGINAL neutral mouth/eyes so facial expression can be controlled separately in Live2D; no new face design, no chibi proportions. Maintain original small fine brown/black linework, angular shaded lab coat folds, subtle VN raster texture. Do not apply a generic smooth modern anime redraw.
Preserve buttoned white lab coat, white shirt, dark-red tie, brown cuff lining, buttons/pockets. Only add perspective-specific folds and redraw the shoulder/torso and arm positions necessary for the forward lean. No brown jacket or added accessories.
Transparent portrait canvas, head to lower coat, entire elbow and hands inside frame with margin. True alpha background, no text, interface, scenery, lighting effect, watermark or floor. The defining requirements are forward depth and hand on waist, not just zooming the original image.
